description: Plain-language risk for a position: distance to liquidation, weekend gaps, expiry, settlement rules, USDG pause and freeze risk. Pass owner for a real position, or collateral and debtTokens for a hypothetical one.

collateral.description: Hypothetical collateral, in USDG as a decimal string, e.g. "11" or "25.5"

debtTokens.description: Hypothetical debt, in synth tokens as a decimal string, e.g. "0.0189"

market.description: Market address (0x...) or symbol, e.g. NO-NVDA

owner.description: The user's wallet address (0x...). Used to read the position and as the simulated sender; nothing is signed.

name: explain_risk
title: Explain risk
